== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Mournful Roar: the entry “Mournful Roar” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 92. Image for [[Mournful Roar (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 92 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a margin of up to 6 points.

SHA-1 <code>5932d6645fda6a3531928c660e82d174431b7067</code>, SHA-256 <code>3c3b1d87de82b215dc24c1d8f57113481e3bcaf82d17b4f81610e485d82408dd</code>.
